title.zh: 宪法财政程序修正命令 2003

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-39-2003-CONSTITUTION-FINANCIAL-PROCEDURE-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2003.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 7 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Financial Procedure) (Amendand shall commence on the 1st. April, 2004.

The Constitution (Financial Procedure) Order, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, and all other written laws shall be construed subject to such modifications as may be necessary to bring them into conformity with this Order. of section 2 of Constitution III.
Section 2 of the principal Order is amended, in the definition of "financial year", by deleting "December" and by substituting "March" therefor. of Chapter 4.

Section 3 of the Interpretation and General Clauses Act is amended, in the definition of "financial year" in subsection jl}, by deleting "December" and by substituting "March" therefor. of Chapter 152.
Section 2 of the Audit Act is amended, in the definition of "financial year", by deleting "December" and by substituting "March" therefor. of S 1/83.
Regulation 39 of the Financial Regulations is amended by deleting and by substituting "March" therefor. powers.

The Minister may give such directories in either a particular matter or in matters of a specified class or description or generally, as may appear to him to be or expedient to meet any difficulty arising from the construction of this Made this 7th. day of Rabiulakhir, 1424 Hijriah corresponding to the 7th. at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei THE SULTAN AND YANG DI·PERTUAN

DARUSSALAM
